The company was formerly known as Korea Flange Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Korea Movenex Co., Ltd. in March 2023. Korea Movenex Co., Ltd. was founded in 1974 and is headquartered in Ulsan, South Korea.

name: SONGWON INDUSTRIAL CO., LTD.
businessSummary: Songwon Industrial Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells polymer stabilizers, tin intermediates, PVC stabilizers, and specialty chemicals in South Korea, Rest of Asia, Europe, North and South America, the Middle East, and Africa. The company operates in two segments: Industrial Chemicals and Performance Chemicals segments. It offers phenolic, phosphite, thioester, and aminic antioxidants; binary blends; application specific antioxidants; hindered amine light stabilizers; UV absorbers and hydroxybenzoates; and high melter, low melter, nucleator and clarifier, and highly loaded UV blends, as well as blends including liquid components. The company also provides a range of antioxidants for fuels and lubricants, as well as fuel additives as stabilizers; tin intermediates; PVC stabilizers and plasticizers, including one pack systems for PVC stabilization, mixed metal stabilizers, metal soap stabilizers, organo-tin stabilizers, auxiliary stabilizers and lubricants, and plasticizers; and specialty polymers comprising polyester diols, thermosetting and/or thermoplastic polyurethanes, and thermoplastic polyurethanes. In addition, it offers coatings, specialty chemicals for fast-moving industries, including electronics and functional monomers for various applications. It serves the adhesive, agriculture, automotive, building and construction, coatings, durable and consumer goods, electrical and electronics, fuels and lubricants, packaging, wire and cable, and textile and fibers industries. Songwon Industrial Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1965 and is headquartered in Ulsan, South Korea.

name: KBI DONGKOOK IND.CO.,LTD.
businessSummary: Kbi Dongkook Ind.Co.,Ltd. provides automobile components in South Korea. It offers interior and exterior components, and lamp parts; and AC motors, alternators, starter motors, seat ventilation heating modules, ventilation boosting modules, slit coils, transformer cores, motor cores, shaded coils, winding, die casting products, fans, and housing products. The company was founded in 1955 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.

name: TDSPHARM
businessSummary: Tdspharm Co., Ltd. researches, develops, and produces pharmaceuticals and cosmetics in South Korea and internationally. It offers general medicines, prescription drugs, and non-medicinal products. The company was founded in 2002 and is based in Seongnam-si, South Korea.

name: POSCO STEELEON CO., LTD.
businessSummary: POSCO STEELEON Co., Ltd. manufactures, processes, and sells steel products in South Korea and internationally. It provides hot-dip galvanized and aluminized-plated steel sheets. The company provides coated steel sheets and color steel sheets. It serves construction and electronic appliance industries. The company was formerly known as POSCO Steel Plate Co., Ltd. and changed its name to POSCO STEELEON Co., Ltd. in March 2022. The company was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Pohang, South Korea. POSCO STEELEON Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of POSCO Holdings Inc.

name: KISHIN CORPORATION
businessSummary: Kishin Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, provides mold bases, parts, die sets, and material in South Korea and internationally. It offers mold bases for plastic injection, as well as parts; press die sets and inner plates; precision plates; and plastic mold steel products. The company was founded in 1975 and is headquartered in Incheon, South Korea. Kishin Corporation is a subsidiary of Futaba Corporation.

businessSummary: NHN Corporation, an IT company, provides gaming, payment, entertainment, IT, and advertisement solutions in South Korea and internationally. The company also provides Ticketlink, a concert, culture, and sports ticket booking service; comico webtoon, an internet webtoon studio; Doctortour, a travel service that offers various travel packages; Dighty, AI-based data solution and services; Dighty Data Market, a data hub that sells web and app data product and data-based insight contents; ACE Counter, a real-time web and app integrated log analysis service; and Audiens, a customer data platform. Mobile. The company was formerly known as NHN Entertainment Corp. and changed its name to NHN Corporation in April 2019. name: DUKSUNG CO., LTD.
businessSummary: Duksung Co., Ltd. produces and sells synthetic leathers in South Korea. The company offers artificial leathers, synthetic resins, materials for cosmetics, polishing pads, textiles, wet dressing products, and intermediate organic material products for organic light-emitting diodes (OLEDs). It also operates waste recovery and recycling facility. The company was formerly known as Duksung Chemical Industry Co. and changed its name to Duksung Co., Ltd. in March 2000. businessSummary: Day1 Company Inc. engages in the educational content development and service business in South Korea. The company was founded in 2013 and is based in Seoul, South Korea.

businessSummary: TEMC CNS Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells semiconductor materials and equipment. It also operates in chemical business. The company manufactures semiconductor and secondary battery-related equipment, semiconductor materials. The company was formerly known as Oceanbridge Co., Ltd and changed its name to TEMC CNS Co., Ltd. in March 2024. TEMC CNS Co., Ltd. was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in Anseong-si, South Korea.

name: BOHAE BREWERY CO., LTD.
businessSummary: BOHAE BREWERY Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells liquor products in South Korea. It offers alcohol products and wines under the Leaves, Bokbunjaju, Original, Soonhee, Brother Soda, Bohae Gold, and Millennium, BIDAN, and HOUKAI brands. The company was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in Changwon-si, South Korea.

name: THE NATURE HOLDINGS CO., LTD.
businessSummary: The Nature Holdings Co., Ltd. operates as a lifestyle company. It develops, produces, and distributes camping gear bags, carriers, and camping equipment, including clothing and shoes, as well as sports apparel, cosmetics, ceramic ware, and wedding dresses for women. The company offers its products under the National Geographic, BARREL, MARK GONZALES, BROMPTON LONDON, DEUS EX MAHINA, NFL, and VERA WANG brands. The company was founded in 2004 and is based in Seoul, South Korea.

name: KYOBO SECURITIES CO.,LTD.
businessSummary: Kyobo Securities Co., Ltd., a securities company, engages in trading, brokerage, agency, and underwriting of listed securities businesses in South Korea. It is involved in consignment trading of securities, brokerage or agency of trading, and related business activities; and business activities related to stocks, bonds, and stock indices for trading purposes, as well as related to derivatives traded on and off the exchange, such as futures and options. The company also provides investment banking services, including securities acquisition, sales, and arrangement; M&A brokerage; corporate financing and operation consulting; asset securitization; and project financing. In addition, it offers asset management, wealth management, real estate management, and proprietary fund management-related services. The company was formerly known as Daehan Securities Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Kyobo Securities Co., Ltd. in April 1994. Kyobo Securities Co., Ltd. was founded in 1949 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea. Kyobo Securities Co.,Ltd. is a subsidiary of Kyobo Life Insurance Co., Ltd.

businessSummary: DYA Co.,Ltd manufactures and sells automobile seats in South Korea. The company engages in lease and toll processing services. businessSummary: Samyang Packaging Corporation manufactures and sells PET bottles for beverages, food, and various other purposes in South Korea. name: ANAM ELECTRONICS CO.,LTD.
businessSummary: Anam Electronics Co.,Ltd., a multimedia company, manufactures and sells audio products in South Korea and internationally. It engages in the brand licensing of TVs, ear plugs, cables, and clocks. The company was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.

It offers cylinder blocks and fly wheels; brake discs and drums; oil-pump housing and pressure plates; and turbine and bearing housings. The company was founded in 1977 and is based in Changwon-si, South Korea.

businessSummary: Nexen Corporation manufactures and sells rubber products in South Korea. It provides logistics services comprising of sea, bulk, air, inland transport and distribution, warehouse, and knock down. The company exports and distributes its products to approximately 140 countries. Nexen Corporation was founded in 1968 and is headquartered in Gimhae-si, South Korea.

name: HITEJINRO CO., LTD.
businessSummary: HITEJINRO Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells alcoholic beverages in South Korea. It provides beer, soju, bottled water, and other products. The company was formerly known as Jinro Ltd and changed its name to HITEJINRO Co., Ltd. in September 2011. HITEJINRO Co., Ltd. is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.

name: PYUNG HWA INDUSTRIAL CO., LTD.
businessSummary: Pyung Hwa Industrial Co., Ltd. produces and sells anti-vibration, air suspension, and hose auto parts for automobiles and equipment facilities in South Korea and internationally. It provides anti-vibration systems, including powertrain mounts, suspension and chassis, advanced products, engine systems, and engine belt systems; products for fuel systems, braking/steering systems, and air and cooling systems; and caterpillar and road wheel rubber products for combat vehicles and specialized rubber. The company was founded in 1950 and is headquartered in Daegu, South Korea.

name: SEOULIN BIOSCIENCE CO.,LTD.
businessSummary: Seoulin Bioscience Co.,Ltd., a bio healthcare company, provides solutions in life sciences and healthcare primarily in South Korea. The company offers solutions for bio research and production; ecoTree, a SLB-120 instrument which produces slightly acidic electrolyzed water for used in food industry, living, and laboratory; plasma-based medical esthetics; miQ for the diagnosis of dementia; and functional cosmetics based on natural fermentation. Seoulin Bioscience Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Seongnam-si, South Korea.

name: WONIL SPECIAL STEEL CO., LTD.

Its products are used in a range of industries, such as automotive, electronics, aviation, machines, ships, nuclear energy, tools, and appliances. The company was incorporated in 1977 and is based in Siheung-si, South Korea.

businessSummary: DK Life Science Co., Ltd., a pharmaceutical company, develops and sells diagnostic medicines and medical devices in South Korea and internationally. It offers active pharmaceutical ingredients (API), injections, blood glucose self-monitoring device, Mobile CT equipment, and ultrasonic instruments. The company also offers catheters, MRI, CT scanner, ultrasound, mobile CT scanner, and X-ray equipment, as well as mammography image analysis assistance software. DK Life Science Co., Ltd. was founded in 2017 and is based in Seoul, South Korea.

Its products are used in marine paints, heavy-duty coatings, powder coatings, coatings for civil engineering and construction, consumer goods, packaging materials, and materials for transport equipment; industrial paints and coatings, paints for construction, heavy duty anticorrosive paints, adhesives, and electric and electronic materials; wind power, transfer vehicles, and industrial and consumer goods; insulation materials and flooring; printed circuit board (PCB) materials, semiconductor packaging materials, functional plastic, high-performance film materials, and heavy electric materials; conductive adhesive films; coatings, industrial printing ink, and 3D-printing materials; and electrodeposition coatings. The company was formerly known as Kukdo Chemical Industry. Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Kukdo Chemical Co., Ltd. in April 1999. The company was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.

name: BOOSTER CO., LTD.
businessSummary: Booster Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells boilers in South Korea. The company offers oncethrough, vacuum hot water, non-furnace scrum, no pressure hot water, and pellet boilers, as well as heat pump, particulate matter baghouse system, compact unit system, and other devices. It also provides booster system, including scrum system, booster multi-control tower system, booster internet of things system, and energy diagnostic machine. Booster Co., Ltd. was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Jincheon-eup, South Korea.

name: HANJIN LOGISTICS CORPORATION
businessSummary: HANJIN Logistics Corporation provides transportation and logistics services in South Korea and internationally. The company provides inland transportation services; and stevedoring services for cargoes, including containers, industrial goods, automobiles, heavy cargoes, grains, steel products, iron ore coal, and transported goods. It also offers marine transport services for steel products, general cargo, heavy cargo, and radioactive waste products; warehousing, air and sea forwarding, packaging moving, express, and small package delivery services; and maintenance services for logistics. In addition, the company operates oil and gas stations. The company was formerly known as Hanjin Transportation Co., Ltd and changed its name to HANJIN Logistics Corporation in August 2025. HANJIN Logistics Corporation was founded in 1945 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.

name: BIONOTE, INC.

name: HK CO., LTD.
businessSummary: HK Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells laser cutting machines in South Korea and internationally. The company was formerly known as Hankwang Co., Ltd. and changed its name to HK Co., Ltd. in March 2015. HK Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Hwaseong-si, South Korea.

businessSummary: Jeil Pharma Holdings Inc manufactures and sells ingredients of drugs, incrementally modified drugs, and generic drugs in South Korea. It also offers building material comprising cement, remicon, dry motor, and other cement related products. In addition, the company investment and financing services for new businesses; operates a school and amusement park. Asia Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1957 and is based in Seoul, South Korea.

name: SIDIZ.INC.

Sidiz.Inc. was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Pyeongtaek-si, South Korea.

name: SNT DYNAMICS CO.,LTD.

The company was formerly known as S&T Dynamics Co. Ltd. and changed its name to SNT DYNAMICS CO.,Ltd. in February 2021. SNT DYNAMICS CO.,Ltd. was founded in 1959 and is based in Changwon-Si, South Korea.

name: DAESANG CORPORATION
businessSummary: Daesang Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, manufacture seasonings and food additives products in Korea, Asia, the United States, Europe, Oceania, and Africa. It operates through Food and Material segments. The company offers general food products, including bean pastes and seasonings; agro-fishery food, such as vinegar and fish sauce; and fresh food products comprising Kimchi and tofu, western food, deli, and frozen food. Daesang Corporation was incorporated in 1956 and is based in Seoul, South Korea.

The company offers TVs, home appliances, air solutions, monitors, automotive components and solutions; LG displays, including mobile, IT, TV, and automotive display products. name: DAEWON KANG UP CO., LTD.

name: CJ ENM CO., LTD.

It also provides wedge bulbs comprising dashboard indicator light/door courtesy lamp, position lamp/license indicator light, map, room/high mounted stop lamp, and overhead console/reverse/rear combination lamps; festoon bulbs comprising map and room/truck/glove box/toilet mirror/door courtish, and personal lamps; and halogen bulbs comprising head lights and fog lamps. The company was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Gwangju-si, South Korea.

businessSummary: JOOYONTECH CO., Ltd engages in the manufacture and sale of PCs in South Korea. businessSummary: Chorokbaem Media Co., Ltd. operates as digital entertainment content producing company in primarily in Asia. businessSummary: KG Chemical Corporation manufactures and supplies fertilizers and concrete compound ingredients products in South Korea and internationally.
